name: SVC_WO_LINK_TEMPLATES_B
description: This table is used to store and represent the link template information in field service work orders using Oracle Field Service linking feature.

columns.name: LINK_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: An autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: LINK_TEMPLATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Property used to uniquely identify the link template.

columns.name: LINK_TEMPLATE_CAT_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the category of the link template, such as Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start, Simultaneous, Related.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the minimum interval in the link template, such as Adjustable, Non-adjustable.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL_MINUTES
columns.description: Property used to indicate the minimum time interval between activities.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the maximum interval in the link template, such as Adjustable, Non-adjustable.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL_MINUTES
columns.description: Property used to indicate the maximum time interval between activities.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_CONSTRAINT_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the assignment constraint in the link template, such as Different resources, Same resource.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_CONSTRAINT_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the scheduling constraint in the link template, such as Different days, Same day.

columns.name: LINK_TYPE_LABEL_FIRST
columns.description: Property used to indicate the label of the first activity.

columns.name: LINK_TYPE_LABEL_SECOND
columns.description: Property used to indicate the label of the second activity.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if a specific template is active.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.
